mechanism: Paroxetine inhibits CYP2C9 and may increase valproate levels; valproate may displace paroxetine from protein binding and both agents increase CNS depression and bleeding risk.
action: Monitor for increased valproate toxicity (tremor, ataxia, sedation) and bleeding signs; consider INR/PT monitoring if patient on anticoagulation; dose adjustments may be necessary based on clinical response.
